notes: All entries select the same existing contact and causal envelope law; labels never select species dynamics.
Mass is encoded to the nearest keV/c2 with at most half a unit error. These are central reference values, not a universal mass quantum.
mass_assigned=0 marks an unassigned mass: its zero storage placeholder is not a zero physical mass. Flavor neutrinos have no single definite catalog rest mass.
One gluon multiplet entry is a generic probe, not an implementation of eight color modes. Spin is a passive quantum number, not a spatial vector or exchange-statistics law.
All other catalog properties and interaction families remain linked reference metadata. No QCD, weak decay or reciprocal electromagnetic response is supplied by this experiment.
